ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a contour map. In the southwest part there is a coastline and ocean shading. a and b are located near the southwest part of the figure, and d is located in the middle-northern part of the figure. In the figure, contour labels such as 200 m, 600 m, and 1000 m can be seen. Slightly right of the center there is also a triangular mountain peak, labeled 3560 m; in the northwest part there is another 2435 m mountain peak. The area around ab is near the low-elevation area along the southwest coast, and nearby mainly lower contour lines such as 200 m and 600 m can be seen. bd goes from b northward to d; along the way it approaches the central highland, and is close to the mountain peak labeled 3560 m and the distribution area of contour lines such as 600 m and 1000 m. Then reason: The size of terrain relief mainly depends on the difference between the highest and lowest elevations along the line or nearby. The elevation change range near section ab is relatively small; section bd extends from a lower place toward the central highland, and the elevation span is larger. Therefore section bd has greater terrain relief.

method.method_draft: 先读图：在等高线图中找到 a、b、d 三点位置，观察 ab 与 bd 两段沿线或附近经过的等高线数值。ab 一带主要在西南沿海附近，接近低海拔区域，附近等高线多为 200 m、600 m，海拔变化范围较小；bd 从 b 向北到 d，沿途靠近中部高地和标注 3560 m 的山峰，附近还有 600 m、1000 m 等等高线，海拔跨度明显更大。再根据地势起伏大小取决于沿线最高、最低海拔差，判断 bd 段地势起伏更大。
